notes.title: Picnic Penguin Coming Soon!
notes.notes:
Picnic Penguin is Ready – Launching Soon with Extra Content! 🐧🍫

Hey everyone! Picnic Penguin is officially ready and launching soon on Steam! 🥳 Get ready to push blocks, collect tasty snacks, and solve tricky Sokoban-style puzzles in this charming arcade puzzle adventure.

But that’s not all! The Steam version includes extra content, making this the best Picnic Penguin experience yet.

Stay tuned for the release date, and don’t forget to wishlist the game to be the first to dive into the puzzle madness!

Thanks for your support ❤️
